text: Incidences of speeding on residential streets appear to have increased significantly, especially in the Mimico neighbourhood of Ward 6. In 2015, several petitions were submitted by residents requesting speed limit reductions from 50km/hr to 30 km/hr on Superior Avenue, Stanley Avenue, Albert Avenue, Cavell Avenue, and Burlington Street, but the 30km/hr speed limits were not warranted. I am requesting the speeds on these roads be reduced to 40 km/hr, and increased enforcement by Toronto Police.

Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Reduced the speed limits on Superior Avenue, Stanley Avenue, Albert Avenue, Cavell Avenue, and Burlington Street from 50 km/hr to 40 km/hr. 2. Requested the Director, Transportation Services, Etobicoke York District, to request increased speed limit enforcement on Superior Avenue, Stanley Avenue, Albert Avenue, Cavell Avenue, and Burlington Street once the new speed limit signs are posted.
